controls.title: Controls
controls.text:
WASD or arrows — to move
Mouse Wheel — to change the camera zoom
LMB — Interact with items and tools by clicking at them
RMB - Quickstart for juicer and coffee machine
R — to open recipes menu
Tab — to open bag (you need to buy it)
G — to drop holding item
F5 — to save the game

hunger.title: Needs
hunger.text:
Hunger, thirst and fatigue affect the speed of movement and the ability to run.
To feed the pony, take something edible and press LMB on her with it.

craft.title: Drinks crafting
craft.text:
To make juices you need to buy and use juice machine.
To make coffee you need to buy and use coffee machine.
The juicer and the coffee machine can be started via the menu or by clicking on them with RMB when they have ingredients.
To make cocktails you need to to mix the ingredients by clicking at them with LMB.
You can buy recipes for cocktails from Twilight Sparkle (the purple one).
Basic simple recipes (juices and coffee) are not bought and are discovered experimentally.

opening.title: Bar opening
opening.text:
To open the bar you need to add to the bar menu at least one drink and press "Closed" sign.
If bar menu is empty, the bar will be automatically closed.
If you leave the bar, it will be automatically closed in minute.

selling.title: Drinks selling
selling.text:
The cost of drinks is selected manually experimentally. If customers don't buy your drinks, try to lower the price.
When a customer chooses which drink they want to buy, an icon of their chosen drink appears above it. To sell a drink, you need to click on the customer.
You can also sell a drink by placing it on the counter. If a customer chooses a drink that is already on the counter, they will automatically buy it.

radio.title: Radio
radio.text:
The radio is sold on the market in the city.
The radio turned on in the bar increases the chance of customers coming.

bank.title: Bank
bank.text:
You can take out an interest-free loan for two days at the bank in town. 
You can take any amount from 1 to 1000 bits.
You can have only one bank loan at a time.
If you do not repay the loan within two days, the game will automatically end.
